content.title: About
content.content: Potato hash brown with cheese is a ready‑to‑heat product consisting of pan‑fried potato patties mixed with grated cheese. It can be quickly prepared in a microwave or on a skillet, delivering the classic potato flavor combined with a creamy, slightly salty cheese note.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Traditional hash browns are made from grated potato, onion and egg, but the ready‑to‑heat version often uses gluten‑free binders.
The added cheese gives a golden crust when heated and boosts calcium content.
The product can be stored in the freezer for up to 12 months without loss of taste.
In many countries variations include herbs, bacon or sour cream, but the basic version contains only potato and cheese.
Microwave heating usually takes 2–3 minutes, while skillet cooking takes 5–7 minutes.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potatoes are rich in potassium, which supports normal heart and muscle function.

items.title: Vitamin C content
items.content: Potatoes provide vitamin C, an antioxidant that helps strengthen the immune system.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: The cheese adds calcium, essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Quick energy
items.content: Hash browns deliver fast‑acting carbohydrates, useful for an active day.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Potato patties contain a modest amount of fiber that aids digestion.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Cheese may trigger allergic reactions in people with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: High sodium
items.content: The product often contains added salt; individuals monitoring sodium intake should watch portion size.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Cheese‑filled hash browns are relatively calorie‑dense, so they should be eaten in moderation.

items.title: Trans fats from frying
items.content: If cooked on a skillet with oil, a small amount of trans fats can form.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the hash browns in the microwave (2–3 min) or in a dry skillet until golden. Serve with sour cream, yogurt dip, fresh herbs, or tomato sauce.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen hash browns in an airtight bag at –18 °C. After thawing, cook immediately. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
